# Keyboard

<!-- Generated from src/lib/os/shortcuts.ts by `pnpm docs:generate`. Do not edit. -->

Every shortcut on the desktop (13 in all). On a Mac, Ctrl is Cmd. The Terminal's `man keys` prints the same list.

## Desktop

| Keys             | What it does                                            |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Ctrl+K           | Open or close the command palette                       |
| Alt+Shift+Arrows | Snap the active window left or right, maximise, restore |

## Boot

| Keys                | What it does           |
| ------------------- | ---------------------- |
| Esc / Enter / Space | Skip the boot sequence |

## Desktop icons

| Keys                | What it does               |
| ------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Enter               | Open the selected icon     |
| Arrows / Home / End | Move between desktop icons |

## Windows

| Keys | What it does             |
| ---- | ------------------------ |
| Esc  | Close the focused window |

## Window title bar

| Keys   | What it does                         |
| ------ | ------------------------------------ |
| Arrows | Snap, maximise or restore the window |

## Terminal

| Keys      | What it does                       |
| --------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Up / Down | Walk the command history           |
| Tab       | Complete a command, path or app id |
| Ctrl+L    | Clear the screen                   |
| Ctrl+C    | Cancel the line being typed        |

## Minesweeper

| Keys   | What it does                                        |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| F      | Flag the cell under the pointer or the focused cell |
| F2 / N | Start a new game                                    |
